basic_details.job_title: MRVC Project Engineer Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 9 Posts
basic_details.short_information: Mumbai Railway Vikas Corporation Ltd. (MRVC) has announced 9 vacancies for Project Engineer (Signal & Telecom) posts on a contract basis for an initial period of two years. Candidates applying for this position must possess a four years Bachelor's Degree in Electrical, Electronics, Information Technology, Communication Engineering, Computer Science, Computer Engineering or M.Sc Electronics, with the upper age not exceeding 30 years as on 15 December 2026. The notified pay is Rs. 40,000-1,40,000. Eligible applicants can apply by email, sending the duly filled application along with mandatory do

application_fee.details: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification.

Minimum 02 years of post-qualification work experience in the field of Signal & Telecommunication (S&T) / Electronics & Telecommunication.

Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience.

faq.question: Q1. What is the conducting organization for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by Mumbai Railway Vikas Corporation Ltd. (MRVC) for filling contractual vacancies in the Signal & Telecommunication department.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available under this notification?
faq.answer: There are a total of 9 vacancies available for the Project Engineer (Signal & Telecommunication) position across various categories.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a four years Bachelor's Degree in Electrical, Electronics, Information Technology, Communication Engineering, Computer Science, Computer Engineering or M.Sc Electronics with at least 60% marks and relevant experience.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is 30 years as on 15 December 2026, with age relaxations applicable for reserved categories such as SC, ST, and OBC as per government norms.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for Project Engineers?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a salary in the IDA Equivalent E1 grade ranging from Rs. 40,000 to Rs. 1,40,000 with a basic pay of Rs. 40,000 per month plus perks.

faq.question: Q6. What is the last date to submit the application?
faq.answer: The last date for submitting the completed application form via email is 15 December 2026.

faq.question: Q7. How should candidates submit their applications?
faq.answer: Applications must be sent via email to [email protected] along with self-attested copies of all mandatory documents and certificates.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned or required to be paid according to the official notification released by MRVC.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection procedure for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process includes preliminary screening of applications, shortlisting candidates for document verification and interaction, followed by an interview by a nominated Committee.

faq.question: Q10. What is the duration of the contract?
faq.answer: The appointment is made on a contract basis for an initial period of two years, which is extendable on a yearly basis depending on satisfactory performance.
